title: Rock & Pop
welcome_lead: Guitars, drums and the music of today.
meta_desc: KS3 genres: rock and pop history and instruments.
final_note: Rock and pop power most modern music.

walkthroughs.body_html: Rock and roll began in the 1950s in the USA. Chuck Berry, Little Richard and Elvis combined blues, country and gospel. The electric guitar became its star instrument.
The Beatles exploded out of Liverpool in the 1960s. By the 70s rock split into prog, punk, metal and disco. Pop drew the catchiest bits into mainstream hits.
Today's pop blends rock instruments with electronic beats, samples and digital production. The riff — a short repeated idea — remains a key feature.
